product_risk_or_requirement: Released AI-course hints must be factually correct conceptually sound grounded and reviewable
current_state: Approved sources and proposed controls exist, but no AIGuide release-candidate evaluation or signed AI course-content quality evidence has been completed.
product_requirement: Every released hint must be traceable to instructor-approved AI course material and validated reasoning; the tutor must abstain and provide fallback when supported guidance is unavailable, and critical content errors must block release.
acceptance_criteria: Given the approved AI course corpus, reasoning bank, and release-candidate tutor, When a stratified evaluation is run across every pilot topic, Then there are zero critical errors about foundational AI concepts, evaluation, model limitations, bias, or responsible use, the confirmed error rate is at most 1%, every sampled hint has traceable grounding, and the AI Course Content Lead signs the evidence pack.
evidence_needed: Versioned evaluation set, sampled outputs, error taxonomy, grounding records, remediation log, and signed AI course-content approval

product_risk_or_requirement: The tutor must support learning without encouraging answer copying or replacing productive reasoning
current_state: Progressive hints and reflection controls are designed, but the end-to-end learner journey and over-reliance thresholds have not been acceptance-tested.
product_requirement: The pilot must require a meaningful learner attempt, reveal help progressively, prompt explanation of reasoning, keep graded work outside the tutor, and route repeated direct-answer requests to teaching staff.
acceptance_criteria: Given representative correct, incorrect, incomplete, and direct-answer-seeking learner journeys, When the pilot workflow is acceptance-tested, Then every path records an initial attempt before a complete solution, prompts the learner to explain a step, offers teaching-assistant escalation, and the Learning Experience Owner signs the pedagogical review.
evidence_needed: Journey test record, pedagogical review, escalation rehearsal, learner notice, and owner approval

product_risk_or_requirement: Tutor data and outputs must not become automated evidence for grading or misconduct decisions
current_state: The product scope excludes grading and misconduct detection, but purpose-limitation, access, prohibited-use, incident-correction, and appeal evidence has not been independently reviewed.
product_requirement: There must be no authorized AI-only grading or disciplinary path; tutor logs must be purpose-limited, any proposed secondary use must trigger a new impact and legal review, and an affected student must receive notice, meaningful human review, correction, and appeal if a violation occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given the role matrix, integration inventory, learner notice, and incident scenario, When the independent governance review is performed, Then no role or integration can make an AI-only grade or misconduct referral, all secondary-use requests require re-approval, and a simulated affected student can obtain human review, correction, and appeal evidence.
evidence_needed: Signed role and purpose matrix, integration inventory, prohibited-use policy, secondary-use gate, incident rehearsal, and appeal procedure

product_risk_or_requirement: Final legal classification privacy obligations vendor roles and market scope must be documented before release
current_state: The pilot is limited to Vietnam and preliminary controls exist, but no qualified reviewer has signed the AI classification, personal-data assessment, vendor-role analysis, or EU non-applicability rationale.
product_requirement: Block pilot release until qualified legal and privacy reviewers map the final purpose, data flow, retention, vendors, target market, and excluded grading functions to current Vietnam instruments and record why EU rules are not applicable to this launch scope; any market or intended-purpose expansion must trigger re-classification.
acceptance_criteria: Given the final system purpose, data inventory, vendor data flow, retention schedule, excluded-use policy, and Vietnam-only launch scope, When release approval is requested, Then signed legal and privacy memoranda record the Vietnam classification and obligations, EU non-applicability rationale, responsible roles, required controls, and explicit re-classification triggers.
evidence_needed: Signed AI applicability memo, personal-data assessment, vendor and transfer review, retention schedule, market-scope record, and release approval
